additional_concerns: All 12 required pairs are retained. NOT_APPLICABLE concerns only the typed gift questions; it neither authorizes pruning the advertising duties nor establishes overall candidate correctness.

The supplied source includes the service context, paragraphs 9–10 and footnote 4. The claims' assertions that those passages are missing are stale. Footnote 4 requires retaining the supplemental FAQs and guidance when describing the incorporated advertising standard.

Code of Conduct paragraphs 2.3 and 3.11 and the answer to question 1 of the Code FAQ issued on 30 September 2010 are not supplied as external dependencies. Their full interpretation remains unchecked; the circular still supports its express statements. No supplied dependency IDs identify these authorities.

Scope placement changes executable outcomes. node.2a6321b4ce90763bf0be564e places offer occurrence in Scope; node.97af37a2579f59b0ee43211f, node.6d6e7adc6faa9d94b74c08e5 and both offer-level candidates place promotional linkage there. Its absence therefore produces OUT_OF_SCOPE rather than a negative prohibition answer or positive selected-control compliance answer. Preserve the alternatives of an intentionally restricted assessment domain and substantive conditions misplaced in Scope. Unknown scope can also block otherwise decisive result facts.

Both offer-level candidates combine offer-wide promotional linkage with an existential non-discount gift fact. Unless upstream classification connects the same gift component to the promotion, an unrelated gift could be caught merely because another component promotes a product. Negative aggregate answers also require adequate component enumeration and treatment of unresolved classifications; node.bca408c75cbf8467afafada6 does not expressly state these evidentiary requirements.

The circular defines distributors through distribution of SFC-authorised funds, while the quoted paragraph 3.11 restriction refers to investment products generally. Candidates differ in their express coverage. Implementing the circular's selected context and implementing the broader Code provision remain distinct alternatives; the latter requires the external Code and an explicit scope decision.

Gift, discount and promotional-link classifications remain supplied judgments. Paragraph 9 says additional returns or incentives may be gifts, not that they invariably are. Absence of structured-product status supplies no gift exemption, and a discount in another component does not exempt a separate gift.

In node.142f34016b300f5c110eb249, 'provider' must identify the actor offering the component rather than merely funding or fulfilling it. The source supports an offering-based restriction without requiring receipt or payment, but does not comprehensively resolve third-party offer attribution.

FALSE, OUT_OF_SCOPE and TRUE_IS_COMPLIANT for the selected gift control do not establish general legal permission. Separate advertising and other requirements remain applicable where their conditions hold.

The supplied source does not establish concrete effective dates or the applicable versions of incorporated external authorities. Temporal runtime handling cannot independently establish historical or current legal applicability.
